# Courses and training {.display-name}

::: {.lede}
Five years of MSc statistics and econometrics at Justus Liebig University Giessen;
week-long courses that hand fiscal incidence microsimulation and poverty mapping over
to the finance ministries and national statistical offices that have to run them; and a
continuing training programme for economists at the World Bank.
:::
